description: p-1 places a hold on c-1, the copy becomes available and the pickup timer is sent, and p-1 collects the copy: copy.collected moves the chart back to idle. The chart cancels the pickup timer on leaving awaiting_pickup, but this case asserts nothing about that cancel: a registered send type's observable here is expect_sends, which has no shape for a cancel, so it carries only the timer sent on entry.
